project2.title: A-Level Revision Website (Resources + Planner)
project2.desc:
This project is a lightweight A-Level revision hub built to make self-study more structured and actionable.

It organizes subjects (Math / Physics / Chemistry) and curated external resources in one place, and includes a simple planner that turns remaining papers and remaining time into a readable revision plan. A small check-in UI supports daily consistency, without requiring accounts or a backend.

event5.title: Built an A-Level Self-Study Planner Website
event5.desc: Developed a personal A-Level study website to plan and track revision progress across subjects (Math, Physics, Chemistry, and Further Math). It organizes topics into a clear checklist and timeline, links out to notes and external resources, and includes daily check-ins to build consistency. The main goal was to turn a large syllabus into an actionable plan: what to study next, what’s completed, what’s overdue, and how to adjust priorities as exam dates get closer.

event6.title: Began Designing a Custom Restaurant Ordering System Website
event6.desc: Started planning a self-built ordering system website for a friend’s restaurant, focusing on an end-to-end workflow: digital menu browsing, item customization, table or takeaway ordering, and real-time order status. I explored a clean UI structure and a modular menu design, with the long-term goal of adding lightweight admin tools (menu updates, order management, and basic analytics) so the system can be deployed quickly and iterated based on real operational needs.
